# AccessibleAI

> AI-powered accessibility compliance suite — Chrome Extension + MCP Server for auditing websites and codebases against WCAG, ADA, Section 508, and EAA standards with automated remediation.

AccessibleAI combines automated rule engines (axe-core) with LLM intelligence (Claude) to provide end-to-end accessibility compliance. It detects violations on live websites via a Chrome Extension, analyzes source code at the AST level via an MCP Server, generates framework-specific fixes (Angular, React, Vue, WordPress), and verifies that fixes resolve violations without regressions.

Unlike existing tools (axe DevTools, WAVE, Lighthouse) that stop at detection, AccessibleAI closes the loop: detect → analyze → plan → fix → verify. The remediation engine produces three tiers of fixes: deterministic AST transforms (~35%), LLM-generated framework-aware code (~45%), and structured guidance for manual review (~20%).

## Key Capabilities

- Runtime accessibility audit via axe-core injection on any website
- Multi-standard support: WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 (A/AA/AAA), ADA, Section 508, EAA (EN 301 549)
- Standards mapping layer that resolves any standard to its WCAG criteria and axe-core/ESLint rules
- Framework-aware static code analysis (Angular, React, Vue, WordPress, HTML)
- AI-powered deep analysis: alt text quality evaluation, ARIA pattern completeness, contextual severity
- Automated remediation with framework-specific fix generation (Angular CDK, React hooks, Vue directives)
- Post-fix verification with regression detection and compliance score delta reporting
- Chrome Extension with page overlay, site crawl, and compliance report export
- MCP Server with 12 tools for Claude Code / Claude Desktop integration
- HMAC-based license key system for feature gating

## Architecture

- TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces + Turborepo)
- Chrome Extension: Manifest V3, React popup/sidepanel, axe-core injection
- MCP Server: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, Express HTTP bridge, Claude API
- Static Analysis: ESLint programmatic API, TypeScript Compiler API, @angular/compiler, @babel/parser
- Remediation: AST-based fix templates, LLM-generated patches, unified diff output

## Standards Supported

- WCAG 2.0 / 2.1 / 2.2 at A, AA, or AAA level
- ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) — maps to WCAG 2.1 AA
- Section 508 (US federal) — maps to WCAG 2.0 AA
- EAA (European Accessibility Act) — maps to EN 301 549 / WCAG 2.1 AA

## Frameworks Supported

- Angular (v14-19) with @angular-eslint and CDK a11y patterns
- React (v16-18) with eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y and MUI/Chakra patterns
- Vue (v2-3) with eslint-plugin-vuejs-accessibility
- WordPress with PHP template and Gutenberg block analysis
- Static HTML/CSS/JS with direct file editing

## MCP Tools

- configure_audit: Set compliance standard and audit parameters
- crawl_site: Discover pages from a root URL
- audit_url: Runtime axe-core audit of a single page
- audit_site: Crawl and audit all pages
- analyze_codebase: AST-level static analysis of a frontend project
- import_audit_results: Import Chrome Extension findings
- map_violations_to_source: Map runtime violations to source file locations
- generate_report: Produce compliance report (JSON/Markdown/HTML)
- generate_fix_plan: Prioritized phased remediation plan
- apply_fix: Apply fixes (single/phase/all-auto) with dry-run preview
- verify_fixes: Re-analyze and detect regressions and report compliance delta
- rollback_fix: Revert a specific fix
